name: Garmin Personal API to Google Sheets (365 days)

parameters.content:
## Garmin to Google Sheets: your last 365 days
Pulls your own sleep, HRV, daily health data and activities from Garmin into a Google Sheet. Reruns update rows, they never duplicate. **Personal use only: use your own key and your own data.**

### Setup (about 5 minutes)
1. Create your Garmin Personal API key (it is shown only once, copy it): https://connect.garmin.com/app/settings/personalApiToken
2. Open **Get Garmin Token** and create a Header Auth credential. Name: `Authorization`. Value: `ApiKey YOUR_KEY` (one space after ApiKey).
3. Get the sheet template (GarminData_sheet_template.xlsx) from https://github.com/flothousand/garmin-dashboard, upload it to Google Drive and open it with Google Sheets.
4. Open **Write Daily** and **Write Activities**: connect your Google account, choose your copy of the sheet, then click the refresh icon so n8n reads the headers.
5. Click **Execute workflow** and wait a few minutes.

### Garmin key
Header Auth credential:
Name = `Authorization`
Value = `ApiKey ` + your key
The key stays in n8n and is never written into the workflow.

### Good to know
- Requests go out slowly on purpose (one every 2 seconds). If Garmin answers 429 (too many requests), just run again: rows are updated, not duplicated.
- Change the period with `TOTAL_DAYS` in **Build Requests** (365 by default).
- Garmin tokens last 24 hours; the workflow asks for a new one on every run.
- Daily rows match on `Date`, activities on `ActivityID`.

### Sheet headers (row 1, exactly these names)
The sheet template already has them. n8n only fills columns whose header exists.

**Daily tab:** Date, steps, steps_goal, distance_m, floors_up, calories_resting, calories_active, calories_total, hr_resting, hr_min, hr_max, intensity_moderate, intensity_vigorous, intensity_goal, stress_avg, stress_max, stress_qualifier, bb_min, bb_max, bb_charged, bb_drained, bb_latest, resp_avg, resp_min, resp_max, hydration_ml, hydration_goal_ml, sleep_hours, sleep_deep_min, sleep_light_min, sleep_rem_min, sleep_awake_min, sleep_score, sleep_score_label, sleep_feedback, sleep_avg_hr, sleep_avg_stress, sleep_resp_avg, sleep_awake_count, sleep_need_min, hrv_last_night, hrv_weekly_avg, hrv_5min_high, hrv_baseline_low, hrv_baseline_high, hrv_status, fitnessage_raw, updated_at

**Activities tab:** Date, ActivityID, start_local, name, type, event_type, distance_km, duration_min, moving_min, elapsed_min, elevation_gain_m, avg_speed_kmh, max_speed_kmh, pace_sec_per_km, avg_hr, max_hr, avg_power, norm_power, max_power, max_20min_power, tss, intensity_factor, aerobic_te, anaerobic_te, training_load, training_effect_label, bike_cadence, run_cadence, calories, power_z1_min, power_z2_min, power_z3_min, power_z4_min, power_z5_min, power_z6_min, power_z7_min, updated_at

### Optional
Enable **Diagnose** to see how many requests per endpoint succeeded or failed.
